hole_offset_mm.notes: Neutral zero offset. This is not a proven printer correction.

shaft_offset_mm.notes: Neutral zero offset. This is not a proven printer correction.

press_fit_offset_mm.notes: Neutral zero offset. Generate a fit coupon before relying on a press fit.

slip_fit_offset_mm.notes: Neutral zero offset. Generate a fit coupon before relying on a slip fit.

hole_dimensional_correction_mm.notes: Neutral signed hole correction. This is not a proven printer correction.

shaft_dimensional_correction_mm.notes: Neutral signed shaft correction. This is not a proven printer correction.

hole_slip_allowance_mm.notes: Neutral non-negative allowance. A positive value enlarges a slip-fit hole.

shaft_slip_allowance_mm.notes: Neutral non-negative allowance. A positive value shrinks a slip-fit shaft.

hole_press_allowance_mm.notes: Neutral non-negative allowance. A positive value shrinks a press-fit hole.

shaft_press_allowance_mm.notes: Neutral non-negative allowance. A positive value enlarges a press-fit shaft.

x.notes: Neutral unit scale. This is not a measured scale correction.

y.notes: Neutral unit scale. This is not a measured scale correction.

z.notes: Neutral unit scale. This is not a measured scale correction.

notes: Unverified neutral starter only. It must never be represented as proven calibration.
